user.title: Add a CoolLEDX sign
user.description: Close the CoolLED phone app first: the sign accepts one connection at a time.

confirm.title: Add {name}?
confirm.description: Found {name} ({address}). Close the CoolLED phone app first.

abort.already_configured: This sign is already set up.
abort.no_devices_found: No CoolLEDX sign found. Turn it on, close the phone app, and make sure a Bluetooth adapter or ESPHome proxy is in range.
abort.not_supported: This CoolLED model uses a different protocol.

show_warning.name: Show warning
show_warning.description: Warning triangle, a WARNING label and a scrolling message.

label.name: Label
label.description: Red label shown after the icon.

show_text.name: Show status text
show_text.description: Scrolling or still status message with optional icon.

icon.name: Icon
icon.description: Status icon in front of the text.

mode.name: Motion
mode.description: How the sign moves the text.

show_animation.name: Show animation
show_animation.description: Play one of the 100 built-in animations.

name.name: Animation name
name.description: Exact or partial name, e.g. 'Frequency Comb'.

show_idle.name: Show idle animation
show_idle.description: All-clear: a date-appropriate animation (holiday season, else reading or optics).

mode.name: Choice
mode.description: auto, reading, optics, holidays, halloween, any, or an animation name.

set_reverse.name: Reverse display
set_reverse.description: Rotate the sign 180 degrees (the sign's own setting).
